**Stable ID:** `DATA-05.03` · **Record type:** Work Package · **Workstream:** 05 Licensing, access, consent and rights

Record what each dataset publicly states about consent, personal data, de-identification and opt-out, without handling the data itself.

## Deliverables

- Consent and privacy statement fields
- Sensitive-data flagging rules

## Canonical artifact paths

- `docs/SOURCE_RIGHTS.md`
- `docs/PUBLICATION_POLICY.md`

## Source and evidence requirements

- Consent and privacy assertions cite the dataset's own documentation

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Absence of a consent statement is recorded as unknown, never as consent
- [ ] Datasets with personal data carry a sensitivity flag
- [ ] No personal data enters this repository

## Non-goals

- Re-identification analysis
- Downloading data to verify claims

## Tasks and subtasks

- [ ] `DATA-05.03.T1` Define fields
  - [ ] `DATA-05.03.T1.S1` Define consent-statement fields
  - [ ] `DATA-05.03.T1.S2` Define de-identification and opt-out fields
- [ ] `DATA-05.03.T2` Define safeguards
  - [ ] `DATA-05.03.T2.S1` Define sensitivity flags
  - [ ] `DATA-05.03.T2.S2` Add a validator check against personal data in records

## Dependencies

- Blocked by `DATA-05.01` License identification and per-version rights
- Blocks `DATA-02.06`

- Rights reviewer
